title: Altitude v2 migration manifest
description: Per-component migration state, read by CI to gate feature work and by generators to scope output. See .altitude/history/NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md §6.

deprecateAliasesBy.description: SemVer version by which legacy aliases (tokens, tag suffixes) may be removed.

components.description: Map of kebab-case component name → migration entry.

state.description: Migration state. `legacy` = un-migrated (CI rejects feature work). `dual` = supports old + new APIs, requires `expiry`. `scoped-complete` = fully on the new model.

react19.description: True once the React wrapper passes the contract tests on React 19.

headless.description: True if the behavior has been extracted into a reactive controller (P5).

ssr.description: True if Declarative Shadow DOM + Lit SSR is wired and the SSR fixture renders + hydrates without FOUC.

expiry.description: Required when state is `dual`. SemVer version after which the legacy code path may be removed.
